title: Friend or Foe? Exploring the Implications of Large Language Models on the Science System

bias_targets.methodology: A two-round Delphi study surveying experts to identify and rank the perceived risk of LLMs reinforcing existing biases, dominant voices, and majority positions in scientific research.

A two-round Delphi study surveying experts to identify and rank the risk of LLMs widening the digital divide and reinforcing inequalities between researchers with varying financial resources and access (e.g., researchers who can afford to pay for commercial models vs. those who cannot, and Global North vs. Global South).
